leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a reactive data property to store pagination state (current page, items per page, total items)
Construct computed properties to calculate total pages and visible page range
Apply conditional rendering to display pagination controls only when needed
Bind click handlers to pagination buttons that update the current page
Configure a method to fetch and display paginated data based on current page
Integrate pagination controls with a data table or list component
Manulate the pagination UI to highlight the active page and disable irrelevant buttons
